Featured Article

Personal Story
Diabetes Living · August 2024

My Personal Journey with Type 2 Diabetes

I remember the day I was diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes. I sat in the doctor's office feeling overwhelmed, confused, and — as a professional chef — deeply worried about what this meant for my cooking. Would I have to give up the flavors I loved? Could I still cook for my students the way I always had? This is my story of transformation, of rediscovering food without fear, and of how gourmet low-glycemic cooking gave me my vitality back.
